text:
nora (Docs): Hi team — I put up a small PR to add an example migration checklist for customers moving from shared to Dedicated capacity. Also included a short SDK snippet showing how to pin model versions to a pool. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1328

liam (Infra): will take a look. Curious which model-pinning API you used in the SDK snippet?

nora (Docs): using the infra SDK's attach_model_to_pool call in the example. Wanted to show how to lock a model version and set rollout policy.

tara (SRE): when you mention isolation, make sure we call out that KV caches and GPU allocation are tenant-isolated but the control-plane may aggregate anonymized metrics. Also suggest customers rotate KMS keys if they bring their own.

nora (Docs): added that note. Wording: "Dedicated pools provide tenant-isolated GPU allocation and ephemeral KV caches. Control-plane metrics are aggregated for observability; RBAC and KMS scoping maintain tenant access isolation." ok?

liam (Infra): fine. Two infra nits: the API call is attach_model(pool_id, model_id, pinned=true) not attach_model_to_pool, and the pool's field for burst policy is "burst_config" in the provider.

nora (Docs): updated the SDK snippet to use attach_model and changed the Terraform example to use burst_config. Pasting updated SDK snippet: 

```python
from redwood import InfraClient
client = InfraClient()
# create pool (assumes auth + permissions)
pool = client.create_pool(name="search-dedicated", provisioning_config={"gpu_type":"a100-80gb","min_capacity":2,"max_capacity":8,"burst_config":{"enabled":True}})
# pin a model version to the pool
client.attach_model(pool_id=pool.id, model_id="redwood/gptx:2026-02-15", pinned=True)
print("pool", pool.id)
```

evan (Product): add a short sentence about SLAs for pinned models: if a model is pinned to a Dedicated pool and the pool is in preemptible fallback, customers might experience increased latency; call out that committed contracts reduce fallback likelihood.

nora (Docs): added an SLA callout: "Pinned models inherit the pool's SLA. During preemptible fallback, latency SLOs may be relaxed; customers with committed capacity experience fewer preemptions."

maria (Docs): small editorial: change "inherit" to "are bound to" for clarity. Also add a migration checklist item to validate KMS key permissions before cutover.

nora (Docs): done. Also found a dead anchor in the pricing link, replaced /pricing/dedicated with /pricing/dedicated-reserved.

liam (Infra): Quick Terraform example tweak: provider expects kms_key_arn and burst_config is an object. Example: 

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "search" {
  name         = "search"
  gpu_type     = "a100-80gb"
  min_capacity = 2
  max_capacity = 8
  burst_config = {
    enabled = true
    max_burst = 4
  }
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd"
}
```

nora (Docs): updated HCL. Also added a short section on rollback: recommend keeping a compatible hosted model as a fallback route and configuring a traffic-split canary.

tara (SRE): add precise wording for rollback procedure: "Configure a traffic-split route that forwards 100% to Hosted when pool health < 2/3 replicas or CPU/GPU errors exceed threshold X for Y minutes." We should avoid vague thresholds.

nora (Docs): added a procedural bullet: "If pool health falls below 66% or GPU errors exceed 5% over 3 minutes, switch route to hosted model and open a support ticket." Is that acceptable?

tara (SRE): yes, that's concrete enough for docs. Also add a note that canary deploys to Dedicated use traffic-split routes and respect pool isolation.

ev an (Product): tiny ask — include a short example of cost impact in the migration checklist: e.g., "Projected monthly cost delta = Δreserved + expected burst minutes * price_per_burst_min" and link to pricing.

nora (Docs): added the cost formula and linked the pricing doc. Also included a short email template for customer success to use when we recommend migration.

maria (Docs): approve copy quality.

doc-ci-bot: docs CI passed — https://ci.internal/builds/4978 :white_check_mark:

nora (Docs): thanks all, merging now. I'll ping #customer-success with the migration checklist and the SDK sample. :rocket:
